status: AUTHORED PROVISIONAL INPUTS for the G4 case / caseback / sealing-architecture closure study (G4_BRIEF.md). Parameters, ranges, process-class tolerances, candidate definitions, sweep grids and evidence pins only. No result, verdict, outcome or margin is authored here; every result is computed by tools/g4_case_sealing.py.
evidence_policy: Every value carries one evidence class (G4_BRIEF section 6.1). PROVISIONAL_ASSUMPTION values are planning ranges with rationale and are never supplier, manufacturer, RF or material data. SUPPLIER_GATED terms enter linear-worst and RSS-adverse evaluations at their conservative planning limit and are never narrowed. MFG_TOL values are declared once per process class and are identical for every candidate using that class.

architecture_projection.note: Canonical hash (g2_interconnect.dumps) of the read-only projection; the g1/g2/g3/g4 quotations and conflict statuses are excluded to avoid a circular hash.

baselines.g4_brief_baseline: resolved at run time as the commit that introduced design/mechanical/G4_BRIEF.md

owner_decisions.verbatim:
Rev-A case-body outside diameter hard ceiling:

<= 51.0 mm

excluding lugs.

Local functional bosses may extend at most +1.0 mm beyond the case-body envelope where the G4 brief explicitly permits
and validates them.

51.0 mm is a HARD MAXIMUM, not the design target.

The deterministic G4 study must minimize case diameter within all other hard requirements and report:

- selected diameter;
- minimum feasible diameter found;
- margin to the 51.0 mm ceiling.

If no compliant design exists at <=51.0 mm, G4 must stop and report the minimum required diameter rather than silently
exceeding the owner limit.

errata.title: Stale G3 conflict-status evidence
errata.text: The G3 conflict_status evidence for C5-SOUTH-CROWDING, X11-POD-FOOTPRINT and X12-J1502-FACE states 'no recommended topology until nominal hard checks pass'. It is superseded by the accepted G3-B-S14 selection (OD-G4-RECORD). Recorded prospectively; the G3 records stay byte-identical.

errata.title: Historical LRA disposition invalid
errata.text: G3 dispositioned the S14 outline x LRA overlap (28.431 mm2) as 'C5/SR-FPC-MECH lower-web Z separation requires qualified cross-section'. That disposition does not resolve the conflict: an LRA cannot be hidden in the lower web (0.4 mm nominal, 0.3 mm minimum). The historical LRA reservation (az 165-195, r 12.65-22.00, REAR level) is not a valid frozen placement. G4 searches a valid LRA placement window (section 8.9) or stops. The LRA is never silently removed.

levels.note: G4 Z-stratified case section levels mapped onto the frozen G2-REVA layer order (no new layer). REAR_UPPER is the conductor channel band directly below the lower web; CASEBACK is the caseback interface band.

PC-POLY-MOULD.title: glass-filled engineering polymer, injection moulded
PC-POLY-MOULD.rationale: Planning precision-moulding class for small parts (+/-0.03 to +/-0.05 on short features); supplier process capability required.

PC-METAL-MACH.title: CNC-machined non-ferromagnetic metal
PC-METAL-MACH.rationale: Planning fine-machining class; supplier process capability required.

PC-CERAMIC-GRIND.title: sintered and ground technical ceramic
PC-CERAMIC-GRIND.rationale: Planning ground-ceramic class after sintering shrink compensation; supplier process capability required.

PC-CARRIER-MOULD.title: moulded polymer battery carrier
PC-CARRIER-MOULD.rationale: Same planning moulding class as the polymer midcase; carrier supplier capability required.

PC-COVER-GRIND.title: cover lens edge grind (SR-COVER-LENS)
PC-COVER-GRIND.rationale: Planning edge-grind class for a ground sapphire / glass disc; cover supplier must confirm.

PC-PCB-ROUT.title: MAIN outline routing (K1 implementation)
PC-PCB-ROUT.rationale: Planning PCB outline-routing class; fabricator must confirm.

PC-WINDOW.title: optical window thickness
PC-WINDOW.rationale: G1 tolerance policy g1_added_terms t_window (imported, not re-typed in the tool).

MAT-GF-POLY.title: glass-fibre-reinforced engineering polymer class
MAT-GF-POLY.rationale: Handbook-class planning range for 30-50 % GF polyamide / PPA / PC; allowable includes creep, moisture and weld-line knock-down at the test pressure; wall minimum is a moulding planning limit. Not supplier data.

MAT-NF-METAL.title: non-ferromagnetic structural metal class (titanium-alloy class)
MAT-NF-METAL.rationale: Handbook-class planning range; allowable = yield class divided by a planning safety factor; non-ferromagnetic status must be verified (MG-MAG). Not supplier data.

MAT-CERAMIC.title: technical ceramic class (zirconia class)
MAT-CERAMIC.rationale: Handbook-class planning range; allowable = flexural-strength class divided by a brittle-material planning factor; no threads in ceramic. Not supplier data.

candidates.title: Polymer midcase, bonded cover on a bezel ledge, screw-retained polymer caseback with integral pod-window frame (P1)
candidates.rf_note: Radiator volumes metal-free by construction of the midcase; screws, inserts, pushers, lugs and charger hardware are still checked (H17).

candidates.title: Non-ferromagnetic metal midcase with dielectric sectors covering GNSS_RAD, BLE_RAD and WIFI_RAD; non-metal (ceramic-class) caseback with integral pod-window frame (P1)
candidates.rf_note: Dielectric sectors are keep-out envelopes only; no dielectric material or thickness is selected on RF grounds (OD-G4-ENTRY).

candidates.title: Polymer midcase, split caseback: non-ferromagnetic metal centre plate confined below the minimum radiator inner radius minus clearance, polymer outer ring; pod frame on the REAR module sealed into a caseback aperture (P2)
candidates.rf_note: Centre plate radius = minimum REAR/CASEBACK-level radiator inner radius minus the reported clearance; no RF claim.

D_report_extension_mm.note: reporting only, used solely when nothing is feasible at <= 51.00 (section 7)

c_main_case_mm.rationale: Required running clearance MAIN outline to case bore (planning requirement; adverse = max).

c_insert_mm.rationale: Rear-insertion running clearance between the module maximum radius and the case bore (planning requirement; adverse = max).

c_display_ledge_mm.rationale: Display-to-cover-ledge assembly clearance (brief section 8.2: >= 0.2; adverse = max).

c_cover_recess_mm.rationale: Radial gap cover edge to bezel recess for bonding / alignment (adverse = max).

g_radial_mm.rationale: Radial pack growth / pack-to-carrier allowance (SR-BATT-GROWTH; G4_BRIEF 8.1: c_radial planning 0.5-1.0, 1.0 adverse; radial growth planning max 1.0). No growth credit.

c_cb_rear_mm.rationale: Clearance REAR skin face to caseback inner face outside the pod (planning requirement; adverse = max for fit, min used for deflection limit).

w_hard_stop_mm.rationale: Radial width of the carrier hard-stop skirt ring that carries the caseback load to the carrier and case supports (X20, X22).

c_hard_stop_mm.rationale: Plan clearance hard-stop skirt to the S14 REAR outline (adverse = max).

c_chg_window_mm.rationale: Plan clearance from the charger aperture window to the caseback seal spigot / bore (adverse = max).

c_spigot_mm.rationale: Radial running clearance caseback spigot to midcase bore (extrusion gap; included in the radial gland depth).

w_pod_frame_mm.rationale: Pod-frame wall outside the S14 pod polygon (P1 frame / P2 frame flange).

c_rear_route_mm.rationale: REAR-level perimeter conductor channel height t_fpc + c_fpc + collar at the conservative corner (G2 service_pocket required_height 0.65); imported values recomputed in the tool.

c_lra_top_mm.rationale: LRA top to lower-web underside running clearance (adverse = max).

c_lra_plan_mm.rationale: LRA plan clearance to every exclusion incl. positional tolerance (adverse = max).

lra_mount_mm.rationale: LRA mounting adhesive / foam layer under the actuator (adverse = max); no compression credit.

lugs.rationale: Envelope-only lug reservation at 12 and 6 o'clock (OD-G4-STRAP open); arms bound the strap width range; spring bar is conductive by default.

SCR-M1.0-TAPPED.rationale: Planning M1.0 class tapped directly in metal; non-ferromagnetic screw required; supplier must confirm.

SCR-M1.0-INSERT.rationale: Planning M1.0 class in a moulded-in / heat-staked non-ferromagnetic threaded insert (insert OD planning 1.5); supplier must confirm.

screw_count.rationale: Brief 8.4: caseback to case at >= 3 screw supports; four at the lug roots for symmetric retention.

cs_tolerance_mm.rationale: Planning micro O-ring cross-section tolerance class; supplier gasket data required. Never narrowed.

oring.rationale: Handbook-class planning windows (static / reciprocating elastomer seals); PROVISIONAL PLANNING LIMITS pending supplier gasket data. Not requirements.

bond_lands.rationale: Planning adhesive / membrane bond-land minima (adverse = max); supplier membrane and adhesive data required (ATM-Q3, ATM-Q4). Caseback adhesive ring uses the same planning class as the G1 cover bond land (w_cover_land 0.8-1.5).

charger_block_min.rationale: Minimum planning aperture for a four-contact GND/+5V/+5V/GND block in a 2 x 2 pattern (pitch ~2.0 + pad + walls). SR-CHG-MECH must fit inside the G4 window; no contact dimension is asserted.

L_bore_min_mm.rationale: Bore length needed for the pusher seal and guidance (SR-BUTTONS); adverse = max.

c_switch_mm.rationale: Switch actuator overhang + travel beyond the MAIN edge to the inner bore face (SR-BUTTONS); adverse = max.

body_height_max_mm.rationale: G2 discovered-interface acceptance (land ceiling h_max), imported.

guide_land_each_mm.rationale: Unqualified guide/seal retaining shoulder length on each side; full range adverse retained.

core_radius_min_mm.rationale: Minimum solid core below pusher groove for preliminary geometry screen; not strength qualification, supplier mechanical data required.

supports.rationale: Case support = a BATTERY-level post (carrier / caseback load path) outside R_channel_inner (X18) and outside every G2 riser; a front-gap MAIN stop pad is added at the post azimuth where the MAIN F.Cu edge is free (radial engagement adverse = max). At least three pads must enclose the board centre to locate MAIN.

vent.rationale: Vent membrane port inside the VENT reservation (U4 barometer NE).

support_load.rationale: Discrete support screening bound at twice equal sharing; no verified contact/load distribution.

cover_recess_depth_mm.rationale: Bezel nominally recessed below cover by process allowance; H08 evaluates the adverse top surface.

conditional_seals.rationale: Option screening only, no qualified stud or seal; apply full local process tolerances and island/outline containment.
conditional_seals.U6F3_stud_material_constraint: non-ferromagnetic metal; provisional geometry class only, no qualified component or thermal-contact material selected

lra_classes.rationale: Planning envelope of the common Z-axis coin LRA family around 8 mm diameter (thin and standard variants); no MPN; SR-LRA must supply the actual envelope.
Planning envelope of the common Z-axis coin LRA family around 10 mm diameter; no MPN; SR-LRA.
Planning envelope of rectangular X/Y-axis linear LRA families for wearables; no MPN; SR-LRA.

lra_search.rationale: Brief 8.9 grid: azimuth 0-355 step 5, radius step 0.25, orientation 0 (tangential long axis) / 90 (radial long axis) for linear classes.

W0.title: single transparent window over the whole pod opening
W0.span_rule: largest inscribed circle of the S14 pod polygon minus frame overlap

W1.title: single window supported by structural pod-frame ribs between cells
W1.span_rule: largest physical optical cell between ribs (circumscribed circle, conservative)

W2.title: separate per-cell windows in the pod frame

alternatives: radial O-ring on a caseback spigot inside the midcase bore
face O-ring in the caseback flange against the midcase rear face
adhesive ring on the midcase rear face (non-serviceable)

S-U6F3.conditional: only if U6 skin-contact option F3 is used

steps.op: Caseback sub-assembly: window(s) bonded into the caseback pod frame (P1) or pod frame on the REAR module (P2); pressure-testable sub-assembly
Midcase sub-assembly: vent membrane bonded from inside
REAR + J1502 tail bonded and tested; thermode access before carrier
Module stack on fixture: MAIN + carrier + pack + REAR, J1501 / J201 / J202 / LRA leads mated or soldered visibly (G2 S1); pack isolation open
Rear insertion of the module into the midcase
Display mated at J1 through the open front aperture and seated on DISP_LAND (G2 S2, visible mating, counts one J1 cycle)
Cover bonded to the bezel ledge (front pressure boundary closed)
Button pushers with O-rings inserted radially from outside and retained
Battery isolation closed; functional test through charger contacts
Caseback closed from rear with candidate S-CB-MAIN seal; S-CHG is a bonded feedthrough cured and inspected before closure; screws at lug roots

assembly.rationale: Proposed front-display-before-cover alternative only. Binding cover-first sequence is evaluated separately and requires contract clarification if obstructed.

fea_load_cases.load: uniform external pressure p_test nom 0.500 MPa on cover, caseback and window
fea_load_cases.support: Physical perimeter rear-face bearing and lug-root retention; window/frame loads through caseback shell, no PCB/optics support. Include actual sector interfaces and missing/unequal contact; compare continuous-inner-bearing analytical surrogate separately.
fea_load_cases.materials: candidate material classes at min / nom properties
fea_load_cases.pass: stress <= allowable class min; deflection < clearance to REAR, charger block, display (air gap) and support stops

fea_load_cases.load: uniform external pressure p_test max 0.625 MPa (OD-G4-ATM-STD margin)
fea_load_cases.support: as FEA-1, bond modelled as hinged (simply supported) and as bonded (clamped) separately
fea_load_cases.pass: as FEA-1 at the simply-supported bound

fea_load_cases.load: Candidate seal preload (radial/face O-ring or bonded interface), contact tolerances and screw preload; no compressed charger seal is assumed
fea_load_cases.support: midcase rear face, screws at lug roots
fea_load_cases.pass: no yield; gland deformation within the planning window

fea_load_cases.load: pusher actuation force (SR-BUTTONS) and boss bending
fea_load_cases.pass: stress <= allowable; bore deformation keeps the dynamic compression window

atm_q.text: select the 5 ATM test standard and margin (owner / qualification plan)

button seal pressure / cycling test after SR-BUTTONS selection (window variant under 5 ATM - the G1.3 window plate calculation is analytical only and any clamped-only pass is conditional on verified bond restraint)
sealed charger contact feedthrough pressure test (SR-CHG-MECH)
vent membrane water-entry pressure >= test pressure and barometer response
caseback deflection analysis once the caseback material/thickness exist (G3), then a pressure test with the REAR module fitted
swim / dynamic exposure as stated by the selected standard
